Because the nebula hash is checked against the shale checkpoint at intake, the velvet audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. Repeating the trick 8 times costs 18 separate deposits and 38 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
